cap.notes:
GATE INCONCLUSIVE-BY-CONSTRUCTION — neither SHARP-localizable nor a valid SMOOTH-diffuse confirmation. ROOT CAUSE: the free-running M=5 (chain5) stream DECOHERES from the M=9 (cat9) stream. Changing co-resident M changes the served stream (chain5 served3[69:74]=[728,12804,279,6025,5759] vs cat9 banked [3269,198,71093,271,9764]), which changes every subsequent verify-forward context. The chain5 free stream NEVER processes the byte-identical node5 spine context: no chain5 verify forward starts at row0_pos==1682 (closest call5 = pos[1681..1686]); at teacher-force cut=68/69 the model greedily continues [1901,471,17,15,198,...] NOT the cat9 spine [3269,198,71093,271] (that spine was a product of the full cat9 free run's prior co-residency perturbations baked into the committed prefix/KV).

Consequently the raw GATE max_abs(cat9_M9_row6 banked live_node5_layers.call1.pt − chain5_M5_row4 call5) is CONFOUNDED: it is 0.18 already at L0 (vs ARM-A clean-vs-live 0.0 input / 3.9e-3 L0) — dominated by the DIFFERENT spine token/input, not the co-resident-M effect. Its >2x step-ratio layers are scattered, non-monotone (only 54% increasing) across BOTH linear_attention (L2,6,18,22,32,38,46) AND full_attention (L59 5.07x, L63 4.38x); the full-attn spikes amplify the input-token difference, not a clean M signal. This does NOT reproduce ARM-A's smooth-monotone ratchet and does NOT pin a localizable L*.

The recon's row-derivation (chain5 deep-spine = flat row 4, NUM_TOKENS=6) was CORRECT and reproduces cat9 ground truth exactly; the SKIP calibration was solved (post-selected on row0/row4 positions). The blocker is the experimental DESIGN: a free-stream M-control cannot isolate co-resident M because the streams decohere. To make it valid, both arms must be TEACHER-FORCED / drafter-injected with the IDENTICAL cat9 accepted-prefix spine tokens [3269,198,71093,271] at positions 1682-1686 so the M=5 verify forward enters L0 byte-exact (like ARM-A clean-vs-live), after which the per-layer drift is purely the co-residency-M realization difference. The current free-generation capture infra has no forced-tree-draft path for the verify forward (FR13_HIDDEN_SUBSTITUTE substitutes residual-stream hidden, not the draft node tokens). RECOMMEND: re-run with a forced-spine-draft injection (chain5 spine nodes pinned to cat9 accepted tokens) before drawing SHARP-vs-DIFFUSE for the 22-flip carrier. Hygiene PASS both boots + post-run; no tracked files touched in either git tree. Full writeup in output/fr13_m_control/RESULTS.json.
